question: Does weighting each scored position's root-reference union Top-K KL -- and the structural operators' activation statistics -- by the frozen teacher's Top-K + tail confidence select an initialization that recovers more autonomous task correctness than the standing incumbent B?

motivation.title: teacher-certainty-weighted fidelity, with the candidate's own probability moves scored
motivation.premise: Where the frozen original teacher is certain, its next-token distribution encodes a determinate fact, step or format the compressed student should keep. Where it is uncertain, several continuations are acceptable and the KL to its spread-out distribution is a weaker signal of structural damage.
motivation.why_topk_plus_tail_confidence: Stage V measured version 2's full-vocabulary confidence, normalised by log|V| (about 11.9 nats), sitting near 1 almost everywhere: IQR 0.042-0.055, ESS at least 99.4%, the weighted KL 96-97% of the raw. Most of that scale is spent on tail mass that does not decide the teacher's next token. The entropy of the teacher's own Top-K entries and one tail bucket, normalised by log(K+1), is a coarsening of the same entropy -- the same direction -- spread over the categories that hold the decision
motivation.why_union_support: On the teacher Top-K + tail partition, a candidate that moves probability onto entries outside the teacher's Top-K is scored only through one tail bucket, so different redistributions of the tail look alike. Scoring the candidate's own Top-K entries individually, against the teacher's EXACT probability of each, closes that blind spot at O(T*K) instead of the full vocabulary's O(T*V)
motivation.question: Does weighting each scored position's root-reference union Top-K KL -- and the structural operators' activation statistics -- by the frozen teacher's Top-K + tail confidence select an initialization that recovers more autonomous task correctness than the standing incumbent B?
motivation.role_of_confidence: c_T is a property of the frozen teacher at the calibration and evaluation positions. No candidate can change it, so a candidate cannot lower the objective by becoming confident. It is a PROXY for where fidelity matters; its value is decided by behavioural evidence after recovery, never assumed

hypothesis: Positions at which the frozen teacher is certain over its own Top-K carry the information a small student most needs to preserve, and a candidate's own high-probability moves away from the teacher are part of the damage to measure; spending the structural selection's fidelity budget accordingly selects initializations that recover more autonomous task correctness. This does NOT assume the teacher's uncertain positions are unimportant -- it tests whether down-weighting their KL, and their weight in the activation statistics, helps or hurts.

definition.confidence_categories: top_k entries + 1 tail bucket when top_k < |V|

objective.formula: L_D2(x) = (1/T_x) sum_{t in T_x} c_T(t) KL_U(p_T || q_C)_t, minimized; c_T(t) = 1 - H^{K+1}_T(t)/log(K+1), H^{K+1}_T the frozen original teacher's Shannon entropy over its own Top-200 entries and one tail bucket at absolute probabilities; KL_U on the teacher's Top-200 united with the candidate's own Top-200 plus one tail, against the ROOT for every consumer
fixed: no dynamic weight sum in the KL objective
no threshold, exponent, temperature or hard mask on c_T
K = 200 for both the confidence and the support

teacher_confidence.definition: H^{K+1}_T(t) = - sum_{i in S_T} p_T(i) log p_T(i) - p_T(tail) log p_T(tail), with ABSOLUTE full-softmax probabilities (never renormalized inside the Top-K) and 0 log 0 = 0; c_T(t) = 1 - H^{K+1}_T(t) / log(categories)
teacher_confidence.categories: derived from the support: K + 1 when K < |V| (201 at K = 200), |V| otherwise -- not a typed constant
properties: computed once per position and stored
the same K as the union KL support
not: exp(-H), a temperature, a threshold or a hard mask
teacher_confidence.theoretical_note_only: exp(-H) is a perplexity-style alternative mapping; it is NOT this objective and nothing computes it

distribution_support.applies_to: D2 version 3 only; D1 and D3 keep reference_topk_tail_v1
distribution_support.definition: S_T(t) = TopK(p_T(t), K), S_C(t) = TopK(q_C(t), K), U_t = S_T ∪ S_C (K..2K entries, deduplicated); KL_U = sum_{i in U} p_T(i) log(p_T(i)/q_C(i)) + p_T(not U) log(p_T(not U)/q_C(not U))
distribution_support.topk_tie_break: value descending, then vocabulary index ascending, for both Top-Ks (deterministic_topk). Measured at $0 on real bf16 logits: 73% of positions tie at the 200th value and torch.topk's set differs on 61%
distribution_support.teacher_side: S_T, its log-probabilities and its tail from the root store; the teacher's probability of candidate-only entries RETRIEVED exactly from its stored final hidden state and full-vocabulary log-normalizer through its output head -- no teacher forward per candidate, no O(T*V) cache, never a tail average or zero
distribution_support.teacher_logits: float32 product of the model-dtype final hidden state and the output head (an exact widening), accumulated in float32; the model's own forward rounds the same product to bf16, which this definition does not
distribution_support.tails: the teacher's: its own Top-K tail (complement logsumexp) minus the candidate-only entries' mass, in log space; the candidate's: its own complement logsumexp with U masked. Zero teacher mass contributes 0; teacher mass where the candidate has none is +inf and stays +inf
distribution_support.bounds: KL_{S_T + tail} <= KL_U <= KL_full, for every pair, by the data-processing inequality (U refines the teacher's K+1 partition; the vocabulary refines U)
distribution_support.reverse_kl: on the SAME union partition, roles swapped

acts_directly_on: DEPTH operator-local candidate evaluation: c_T-weighted root union KL

FFN, residual WIDTH and ATTENTION activation statistics: every accumulator -- residual sum and second moment, FFN sum|a| and sum a^2, per-head attention-output second moment -- weighted by c_T, over a sum-of-weights denominator
global state evaluation of every child (reference: the teacher)
beam ranking and pruning (OBJECTIVE_PARETO_V1, the version-3 ranking identity)

denominators.kl_objective: the fixed 1/T_x over the item's scored positions; never the sum of weights
denominators.activation_statistics: sum_t w_t, with w_t = policy token weight x c_T(t); a zero-weight position is dropped like padding

scope.token_alignment: token j carries c_T of prediction j -- the logits its own state produces -- and the item's last token, which feeds no prediction inside the item, carries zero; the supervised-target policy's token weights are its prediction weights with that same trailing zero
not_weighted: the scored-position set, which stays the binary supervised-target policy

rescoring_integration.token_ids: use the generation engine's exact ids, kept by the read-only sidecar wrapper scripts/shared/evaluation/uncapped_eval_token_ids.py. A record with no exact row is rescored from retokenized text, ids_source=retokenized_text, labelled approximate per sample.
